The dialogue now lives in base-diplomacy with the same class name. Dialogues/AdvanceTaken here re-exports it, so every import gets the same class and saves are unaffected (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008).

Both player actions now live in base-treasury with the same class names. Their old paths here re-export them, so every import gets the same class and saves are unaffected (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008).

The released conversions, which still move features themselves, and the ones that leave it to these rules now give the same squares and the same random draws with these rules. The conversion test runs against both (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008).
test: compare against the released conversions

A terrain's features are bound to the Terrain instance, so a change of terrain left them behind unless each caller moved them by hand. Rule sets now decide what follows the square onto its new terrain (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008, G13). Setting the terrain a tile already has processes nothing.
ChooseGovernment sits beside Revolution, so a ruleset gets both steps of a change of government from one place (civ-clone/web-renderer#1008).
The build installs with pnpm, checks formatting and stale compiled output, and runs the new re-export tests; the unused package-lock.json is gone.
